Weather subject is el-dinya (sheet 'El-denia shames'); Amal recast 'الدنيا' straight after.

rows.medi_said: So I say دنيا الجو. ... Okay. دنيا جو.

rows.proposed_rule: Weather takes ONE subject - el-dinya (feminine) or el-jaw (masculine) - never both stacked: el-jaw bared / el-dinya bardeh, not dinya el-jaw.
rows.why: He stacked دنيا + جو twice and Amal said an explicit 'No, no, no. Either دنيا or جو'; no bucket covers a doubled subject.
She had just said دنيا takes feminine (10:48) and el- (11:00), yet he said دنيا بارد with a masculine adjective and no el-; she let it pass.
He said ما قايمة (not standing) for cloudy; Amal supplied مغيمة; sheet 'it's cloudy | M8ayyme | مغيمة' (could be a ق/غ sound slip, hence medium).
